### Batch B001

### Q001 — Unanswered

When startup also includes a concrete task, waiting for a menu choice could delay that task.
When should HAI show the menu and wait for a selection?

Implementation impact: Defines which startup paths require a user response.

- [ ] A: With no task, show the menu and wait; with a task, show the agents/Activity summary and proceed. (Recommended)
- [ ] B: Always show the menu, while proceeding with any explicit task.
- [ ] C: Always show the menu and wait for a choice before work.
- Other: ___

Status: unanswered

### Q002 — Unanswered

The draft does not define which choices the user can select.
What should the top-level menu choices represent?

Implementation impact: Defines the selectable actions and how users reach the appropriate capability.

- [ ] A: Task actions, such as Continue Activity, Work on backlog, Start a task, Agent setup, and Help. (Recommended)
- [ ] B: Registered agents directly, plus Activity actions and Help.
- [ ] C: Task actions and individual registered agents together.
- Other: ___

Status: unanswered

### Q003 — Unanswered

Help appears in the title, but its behavior is unspecified.
What Help should this iteration provide?

Implementation impact: Bounds the Help content and its acceptance conditions.

- [ ] A: A short overview at startup, also available again on request. (Recommended)
- [ ] B: The startup overview only.
- [ ] C: A startup overview plus detailed help for each action or agent.
- Other: ___

Status: unanswered
